name: Refined season comparison
prompt: Refine this season-comparison page without changing its structure, shared site header, selected tabs, exact sample names, record values, percentages or win deltas. Collapse the format disclosure: show only the words Season format and its chevron. Remove the visible team count, regular-season length and playoff qualification sentence from this closed state. Keep champion and runner-up as a compact line with a middle dot between the two facts. Make the table more restrained and precise: body text and numbers approximately 22 pixels at a 1440-pixel-wide desktop viewport, medium weight 500; manager links semibold 600; column labels about 17 pixels and weight 600. Preserve dark numerical ink, tabular digits, right-aligned numeric columns, light dividers, and the existing condensed family. Keep the brand, page year and navigation in their existing shared roles. Give the ten rows a calm consistent rhythm around 44 pixels high. The page ends at the table. No cards, footers, additional metrics, avatars, explanations, status or updated dates. Do not alter the data or reintroduce the old format strip and player highlights.
initialPrompt: A refined desktop season-comparison page for Farls da bag, a fantasy-football history museum, at 1440 by 900 proportions, edge-to-edge, no browser frame. The visitor compares how each manager performed against that season's league and schedule. Use reference 1 only for the shared header, typography, colors and quiet tab/table styling, never its profile content, crest, or timeline. Header Farls da bag, Records, Managers, Seasons selected, Rivalries, and plain Sample stats. Keep identical header scale and colors: dark brand, muted navigation, violet selected underline. On white, a compact 2024 heading with a year-selection chevron and a Season records link. Beneath it, one restrained line identifies Champion Sample rival and Runner-up Sample manager, with linked dark-ink names. A small Season format disclosure replaces the always-visible format statistics. Local tabs Standings selected, Matchups, Playoffs, Players. No large colored header band. The main content is one well-spaced full-width comparison table: Rank, Manager, Record, Scoring vs league, Wins vs expected. Rows: Sample manager / 10–4 / +24.0% / +0.7; Sample rival / 9–5 / +14.3% / -0.2; C / 8–6 / +7.1% / -0.7; D / 8–6 / +3.6% / +0.8; E / 7–7 / 0.0% / -0.4; F / 7–7 / -3.6% / +0.2; G / 6–8 / -7.1% / -2.6; H / 6–8 / -10.7% / -0.2; I / 5–9 / -14.3% / +0.9; J / 4–10 / -13.3% / +1.5. Lettered managers use Sample manager prefix. Right-align measured values, dark ink, calm weights, quiet row dividers. The page ends with the table. No footer summaries, player highlights, metric ribbons, cards, avatars, explanations, calculations, status or update dates. All results are fictional.
approvalScope: Q35 revised accepted as a working season-design foundation, with further mobile polish deferred. Not final whole-platform approval or implemented application code.
approvalQuote: Yeah, 35's a little better. It's okay on mobile but we can figure that out later.
sourceArtworkAuthority: Original source image pixels remain authoritative; generated artwork is not historical evidence.
